semiconductor_relevance: High — Japan Fine Ceramics specializes in advanced ceramic and composite materials that are critical for semiconductor manufacturing and performance enhancement.
summary: Japan Fine Ceramics develops and supplies high-performance ceramic and composite materials tailored for the semiconductor industry. Their products, including Metal Matrix Composites and high thermal conductivity silicon nitride substrates, are designed to improve equipment performance and precision in semiconductor applications.
capabilities: Metal Matrix Composites (MMC) with integrated fluid channels
High thermal conductivity silicon nitride substrates
Electronic ceramics for thin film integrated circuits
